label: launch
narration: Launching the RobOS Agents app from the App Launcher.

label: agents-list
narration: Three agents today — Claude, Copilot, and Codex — with more on the way. Green means logged in; yellow means logged out.

label: blackout-note
narration: I'll black out sensitive data with an overlay — login itself happens through the window that pops up.

label: browser-flow
narration: The browser opens — paste the device code and accept the permissions prompt.

label: logged-in
narration: Logged in. The screen refreshes to show GitHub Copilot is now connected.

label: resume-session
narration: You can resume a previous session from the agents list — every recently-used Copilot session shows up here.

label: custom-args
narration: Each agent can be customized before it launches — we've wired in the common arguments for each one.

label: models-dropdown
narration: The models dropdown is populated from the models you actually have available.

label: name-session
narration: You can name the session whatever you want.

label: session-appears
narration: The sessions view shows our new Dana session — the bug that truncated longer names is already fixed.

label: codex-flow
narration: The same flow works for the other agents — Codex has all the same options.

label: set-default
narration: Back in Copilot, we can pin it as the default — RobOS uses it whenever no specific agent is requested.
